listing.name: Fable II Pub Games (MGRayd Recomp)
listing.summary: Play the Fable II Pub Games recompilation with your own purchased Xbox 360 Pub Games package.

steps.title: Import your own Pub Games package
steps.instruction: Open Fable2PubGamesLauncher.exe, choose your own purchased Xbox 360 Fable II Pub Games LIVE, PIRS or CON container, and use Install Game Files. The launcher unpacks it into the data folder beside the program with its bundled PowerShell extractor. Keep your original container separately; if an import is interrupted, delete the leftover data.extracting folder before trying again. Then use Play Pub Games, and keep the launcher open until the game closes.

steps.title: Use a copy you manage yourself
steps.instruction: Keep the launcher, game program, DLLs and extraction tool together in a writable folder, and start Fable2PubGamesLauncher.exe there. The launcher keeps its settings in launcher-settings.json and the game keeps data, saves, logs and cache in the same folder; preserve them before replacing the program.

steps.title: Review optional Fable II save sync separately
steps.instruction: The launcher's Advanced Options can link the Fable II Recompiled saves folder and sync when Pub Games closes. This copies your Fable II saves into the saves folder beside the program and can update Fable2PubInfo.xml bridge records in the other game’s profile, including changes made with the launcher's Save Editor. Keep your own backups as well as the upstream pubgames-sync-backups, and close both games before any maintenance. Leave sync off for independent profiles.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own purchased full game package; the launcher always starts the full game and does not grant or change an entitlement.
Re-importing game files keeps the previous data folder as data.backup-<date>, a full copy of the game data. Delete old backups when you no longer need them to save space.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, open the launcher, choose your own purchased Xbox 360 Fable II Pub Games container and use Install Game Files; the launcher unpacks it into the data folder of the managed game folder with its bundled PowerShell extractor. Then use Play Pub Games. The launcher always starts the full game; that does not grant or change an entitlement, so use only a full package you own. Keep the launcher open until the game closes: Portcove's session follows the launcher, so closing it early ends the session while the game may still be writing saves. Portcove keeps data, saves, cache, logs, Fable2PubGames.toml (the game's own settings, including F4 'Save to config') and launcher-settings.json across updates, backups and rollback. Re-importing keeps the previous data as data.backup-<date>, a full copy of the game data that moves with the game on updates and is included in backups; delete old ones to save space. If an import is interrupted, delete the leftover data.extracting folder. If you turn on the optional Fable II save sync, the launcher copies your Fable II saves into saves and writes bridge records into the Fable II Recompiled profile, outside the managed copy, which Portcove does not back up. The game uses Windows path APIs that cannot represent every character, so use a short library path with plain ASCII characters; Portcove refuses other install folders before download. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if the game does not start.
